acceptance_criterion: Reassignment proposals are permitted only for events not in status Completed, Cancelled, or Rejected
test_name: refuses reassignment once the event has been rejected

acceptance_criterion: Only one pending reassignment proposal may exist per event, enforced as a database-level invariant under concurrent attempts
test_name: fires two concurrent proposals for the same event and lets exactly one win

acceptance_criterion: Proposing reassignment to the coordinator already assigned is refused and creates no new history entry
test_name: refuses nominating the coordinator already assigned, creating no history entry

test_name: refuses a caller who is not the nominee

test_name: moves coordinator permissions to the nominee and closes the outgoing assignment

acceptance_criterion: On accept, the outgoing assignment is closed, a new active assignment is created for the nominee, and both parties are notified
test_name: writes the reassignment-accepted event naming both coordinators

acceptance_criterion: On decline, no assignment is changed and the proposal is closed and recorded in history
test_name: leaves the outgoing coordinator active and records the decline

acceptance_criterion: On decline, no assignment is changed and the proposal is closed and recorded in history
test_name: allows a fresh proposal once the pending one has been declined
